title: Extract fieldwork-api-mastodon crate from server inline code
description: When we start building the second client API (Pixelfed), first extract the existing Mastodon Client API handlers from the three servers into a fieldwork-api-mastodon crate. This establishes the pattern for all subsequent API crates. The Mastodon API routes, request/response types, and serialization logic that are currently inline in each server's api.rs/posting.rs/interactions.rs move to the shared crate. Servers just mount the router. Do NOT do this until we're actively building the Pixelfed API — premature extraction will guess wrong about the abstraction boundary.
